method: One serial request; alternate version order by round; discard round zero; five measured runs per CLI/MCP case; nearest-rank p95; normal background processes remain active. CLI fresh processes use warm OS cache, not warm JIT.
cli_replay_script:
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import time

root = Path('/home/murphy/source/miller')
baseline = Path('/tmp/miller-perf-baseline-path').read_text()
binaries = {
    'v1.27.2': baseline + '/src/Miller.Server/bin/Release/net10.0/miller',
    'v1.28.0': str(root / 'src/Miller.Server/bin/Release/net10.0/miller'),
}
cases = {
    'search-symbol': ['search', 'FullRebuildPromotion', '--arm', 'lexical'],
    'search-phrase': ['search', 'reader retention registration', '--arm', 'lexical'],
    'search-source': ['search', 'reader_admission_busy', '--mode', 'source'],
    'inspect-summary': ['inspect', 'FullRebuildPromotion', '--depth', 'summary'],
    'inspect-overview': ['inspect', 'FullRebuildPromotion', '--depth', 'overview'],
    'trace': ['trace', 'FullRebuildPromotion', '--mode', 'refs'],
    'context': ['context', 'reader retention registration', '--token-budget', '2000'],
    'impact': ['impact', '--changed-paths', 'src/Miller.Indexing/FullRebuildPromotion.cs'],
}
env = os.environ.copy()
env.update(MILLER_SEMANTIC='off', MILLER_CT='off')
samples = []
for round_number in range(6):
    for name, args in cases.items():
        versions = list(binaries) if round_number % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(binaries))
        for version in versions:
            rss_path = Path('/tmp/miller-perf-review/last-rss.txt')
            start = time.monotonic()
            result = subprocess.run(
                ['/usr/bin/time', '-f', '%M', '-o', str(rss_path), binaries[version], *args, '--json'],
                cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90,
            )
            sample = dict(version=version, case=name, round=round_number,
                          wall_ms=round((time.monotonic()-start)*1000, 2),
                          peak_rss_kib=rss_path.read_text().strip(), exit_code=result.returncode,
                          output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(result.stdout.encode()).hexdigest(),
                          output_bytes=len(result.stdout.encode()), stderr=result.stderr)
            samples.append(sample)
            Path('/tmp/miller-perf-review/cli-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(samples, indent=2))
            if round_number == 0:
                Path(f'/tmp/miller-perf-review/{version}-{name}.json').write_text(result.stdout)
            print(json.dumps(sample), flush=True)
